messages:
Priya Singh: Quick sync 1: Partner ForgeLabs shipped a LangChain adapter. Quick smoke shows streaming works but telemetry tags are inconsistent. Need decision: list as Preview or hold for full cert?
Sam - Integrations: Repro: adapter installs via helm, run against llama-13b with langchain flow. Streaming ok, but telemetry events sometimes miss tenant_id and model_profile.
Leah Kim: Missing tags cause Console to group metrics under "unknown" which breaks per-tenant cost reporting. Also saw one instance of stream chunk negotiation mismatch (adapter wants 512, gateway assumes 256) but it fell back gracefully.
Marta (Partner PM): Marketing wants a short listing next week. Would a "Preview" badge with known-issues be acceptable?
Tess - Marketplace: Yes we can add "Preview: streaming best-effort" but need legal-approved wording and a short known-issues bullet. Also require sample terraform + screenshots.
Lina Legal: Draft legal wording: we can allow a Preview badge but must include a disclaimer and a short SLA note "best-effort streaming". I'll draft copy by EOD 2026-05-02.
Sam - Integrations: Plan: add a telemetry shim to gateway that extracts tenant_id from adapter headers if present and injects model_profile if missing. Also add server clamp for chunk negotiation (256). I can PR today.
Leah Kim: I'll run H100/A10G smoke after the shim lands and post p50/p95 token latencies. Expect numbers within 24h.
ci-bot: CI pipeline #8201 started for branch forgelabs-telemetry-shim.
Priya Singh: Action items: Sam - PR for shim + clamp (2026-05-01), Leah - HW smoke (2026-05-02), Lina - legal wording (2026-05-02), Marta/Tess - listing assets hold until perf. If all green we list as Preview and schedule joint blog cadence.
Marta (Partner PM): Noted. I'll ask ForgeLabs for two screenshots and a short quote.
Sam - Integrations: Opening issue in partner repo about chunk header to nudge them toward 256 as best practice.
Priya Singh: Thanks all. Tagging owners @Sam - Integrations @Leah Kim @Lina Legal @Marta (Partner PM).
